session:
version: 0.3.11
name: flex-kbs
predecessor: null
images:
- name: kbs_image
  injection_files:
  - path: /etc/kbs-config.toml
    content: |
      [http_server]
      sockets = ["0.0.0.0:8080"]
      private_key = "/etc/kbs/tls/tls.key"
      certificate = "/etc/kbs/tls/tls.crt"

      [admin]
      auth_public_key = "/etc/kbs/admin/public-key.pem"

      [policy_engine]
      policy_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/attestation-service/policies/opa/resource-policy.rego"

      [attestation_token]
      insecure_key = true

      [attestation_service]
      type = "coco_as_builtin"

      [attestation_service.attestation_token_broker]
      type = "Ear"

      [attestation_service.attestation_token_broker.signer]
      key_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-ec-key.pem"
      cert_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-cert-chain.pem"

      [[plugins]]
      name = "resource"
      type = "LocalFs"
      dir_path = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/repository"

      [[plugins]]
      name = "scone"
      cas_address = "https://cas.scone-system:8081"
      cas_cert = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/scone/cas.pem"
      identity_key = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/scone/identity.key"
      identity_cert = "/opt/confidential-containers/kbs/scone/identity.pem"
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/attestation-service/policies/opa/resource-policy.rego
    content: |
      package policy
      import rego.v1

      default allow = false

      # /kbs/v0/scone/sign: only nodes whose EAR carries Azure TDX vTPM evidence
      # (qeinit on an Azure TDX CVM). Demo stage: no reference values yet, so the
      # EAR status is not checked; tighten to "affirming" + PCR11/MRTD once captured
      # (see flex-nodes/HARDENING.md).
      allow if {
        data["resource-path"] == "scone/sign"
        some _, submod in input.submods
        submod["ear.veraison.annotated-evidence"].aztdxvtpm
      }
  - path: /etc/kbs/tls/tls.key
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_tls_key$$
  - path: /etc/kbs/tls/tls.crt
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_tls_cert:crt$$
  - path: /etc/kbs/admin/public-key.pem
    content: |
      -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----
      MCowBQYDK2VwAyEAYCicaAqZsAign7ZQ+SxpOfEBu+yrpXMLHfExOxKnrZ8=
      -----END PUBLIC KEY-----
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-ec-key.pem

  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/kbs-cert-chain.pem
    content: |-
      $$SCONE::kbs_cert:crt$$
      $$SCONE::kbs_ca:crt$$
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/ca-cert.pem
    content: $$SCONE::kbs_ca:crt$$
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/scone/identity.key
    content: $$SCONE::scone_identity_key$$
  - path: /opt/confidential-containers/kbs/scone/identity.pem
    content: $$SCONE::scone_identity_cert:crt$$

  - path: /etc/sgx_default_qcnl.conf
    content: |
      {
        "pccs_url": "https://api.trustedservices.intel.com/sgx/certification/v4/",
        "use_secure_cert": true,
        "retry_times": 6,
        "retry_delay": 5
      }
secrets:
- name: kbs_ca_key
  kind: private-key
- name: kbs_ca
  kind: x509-ca
  private_key: kbs_ca_key
  common_name: SCONE KBS flex-kbs CA
- name: kbs_private_key
  kind: private-key
  key_type: P-256
- name: kbs_cert
  kind: x509
  private_key: kbs_private_key
  common_name: SCONE KBS token signer
  issuer: kbs_ca
- name: kbs_tls_key
  kind: private-key
- name: kbs_tls_cert
  kind: x509
  private_key: kbs_tls_key
  common_name: SCONE KBS
  issuer: kbs_ca
  endpoint: server
  san:
  - dns:flex-kbs.trustee.svc
  - dns:flex-kbs.trustee.svc.cluster.local
  - ip:10.91.0.4
- name: scone_identity_key
  import:
    session: kbs-certs
    secret: kbs_ca_key
- name: scone_identity_cert
  import:
    session: kbs-certs
    secret: kbs_ca
services:
- name: kbs
  image_name: kbs_image
  environment:
    RUST_LOG: debug
  command: /usr/local/bin/kbs --config-file /etc/kbs-config.toml
  pwd: /
  persistency: None
  attestation:
  - mrenclave:
    - 740159c37e751ba24321c7d2f8e3f060f6f707b704ca4c42bde3cbaf5258a754
    - 1857edcc29a4f70d2708e91d747a2b10422c65185e83d1be90989e420014d15f
access_policy:
  read:
  - ANY
  update:
  - ANY
security:
  attestation:
    mode: hardware
    tolerate:
    - debug-mode
    - hyperthreading
    - insecure-igpu
    - outdated-tcb
    - software-hardening-needed
    - insecure-configuration
    - aepic-leak
    ignore_advisories: '*'
creator: null
